package members_test

import (
	"context"
	"io"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	pb "example.com/grpcmembers/gen/grpc/members/pb"
	members "example.com/grpcmembers/gen/members"
	item "example.com/grpcmembers/gen/unimplementedMembersServer"
)

func TestMounted(t *testing.T) {
	e := &members.Endpoints{UnimplementedMembersServer: func(_ context.Context, req any) (any, error) {
		input := req.(*members.UnimplementedMembersServerEndpointInput)
		value := "located:" + *input.Payload.Value
		return nil, input.Stream.Send(&item.Item{Value: &value})

	}}
	ctx, client := mountedClient(t, e)
	input := "input"
	stream, err := client.UnimplementedMembersServer(ctx, &pb.UnimplementedMembersServerRequest{Value: &input})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	value, err := stream.Recv()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "located:input", value.GetValue())
	_, err = stream.Recv()
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, io.EOF)
}
